# Sai Kanagat

> Sai Prathyaksh Kanagat is an industrial designer and digital marketer based in Bologna, Italy. His work spans brand strategy, paid media, marketing technology, product design and applied AI. He founded Nishta, a digital marketing practice, and is studying the Master in Digital Marketing & Communication at Bologna Business School. Open to roles from late January 2027.

- [Demos](https://saikanagat.com/demos): interactive browser experiments
- [Contact](https://saikanagat.com/contact): how to get in touch

## Selected projects
- [Cortex Studio](https://saikanagat.com/cortex): multi-agent AI creative studio
